pages: Nell, eight, dark hair in two short plaits, in a bright yellow knitted sweater under blue dungarees, tips one round biscuit tin towards her, its sailing-ship lid lying beside it. Middle distance: a folded paper packet, a glass jar on the table. Background: the kitchen window, flat grey morning light.

Nell, eight, dark hair in two short plaits, in a bright yellow knitted sweater under blue dungarees, holds one black-seeded bean up in her thumb and forefinger and looks at it hard. Middle distance: a line of glass jars on the library shelf. Background: quiet reading room, high windows. Cool grey light.

Nell, eight, dark hair in two short plaits, in a bright yellow knitted sweater under blue dungarees, presses one round biscuit tin down with her palm, the sailing-ship lid shut. Middle distance: a roll of masking tape, a strip of paper. Background: the kitchen shelf and the high cupboard door. Flat indoor light.

Nell, eight, dark hair in two short plaits, in a bright yellow knitted sweater under blue dungarees, lifts the lid of one round biscuit tin with her thumb and looks down at the paper inside. Middle distance: slick grey kitchen paper, beans black at the tips. Background: the kitchen sill, morning sun. Sharp light in her eyes.

Nell, eight, dark hair in two short plaits, in a bright yellow knitted sweater under blue dungarees, bends over one open notebook and rules a line under the figure she has written. Middle distance: the open biscuit tin, a dusting of flour on the table. Background: the doorway, the hall. Low warm kitchen light.

Nell, eight, dark hair in two short plaits, in a bright yellow knitted sweater under blue dungarees, stands on a wooden stool and closes her fingers round one last black bean on a high shelf. Middle distance: the washed biscuit tin on the counter. Background: kitchen wall, a shelf of jars. Dim morning light.

Nell, eight, dark hair in two short plaits, in a bright yellow knitted sweater under blue dungarees, crouches at the windowsill and tilts the open biscuit tin to the light, one white bean root curving down through damp paper. Middle distance: the tin lid leaning on its side. Background: the kitchen window, low sun. Warm gold light.

An old man, white hair, in a brown knitted vest over a checked shirt, stands at the kitchen table with one open notebook held flat in both hands. Middle distance: a lead pencil, the biscuit tin with its lid beside it. Background: the window, a row of jars. Plain morning light on his hands.

Nell, eight, dark hair in two short plaits, in a bright yellow knitted sweater under blue dungarees, sets one washed biscuit tin upside down on a concrete drain, water running off its rim. Middle distance: a garden cane, the compost heap boards. Background: the top garden plot, late afternoon sun. Long shadows.

Nell, eight, dark hair in two short plaits, in a bright yellow knitted sweater under blue dungarees, smooths one strip of masking tape down the side of the round biscuit tin, a pencil in her fist. Middle distance: the open notebook, the tin's clean painted side. Background: kitchen table, low window. Flat grey light.

Nell, eight, dark hair in two short plaits, in a bright yellow knitted sweater under blue dungarees, stands among the young bean plants with one flat green pod turned in her open hand. Middle distance: more canes with vines climbing them. Background: the garden plot, the hedge. Bright June light, wet green.

Nell, eight, dark hair in two short plaits, in a bright yellow knitted sweater under blue dungarees, stands on the kitchen floor looking up at one round biscuit tin on the shelf, a strip of masking tape down its side. Middle distance: the shelf edge, a folded paper. Background: the window, quiet kitchen. Evening light.
